about_the_game:
On Island is an open-world adventure-survival game set in a mysterious archipelago. As a castaway who has lost all memories, you must: survive, explore the islands, and uncover the secrets of the archipelago. Meet new inhabitants, build structures, craft items, recover your memories, and find a way to escape the islands!

Experience an epic adventure

Somewhere on Earth lies a mysterious archipelago, cut off from the rest of the world, where you find yourself stranded. Your goal is to survive while discovering new places and beings. The archipelago holds many secrets, and each island offers new clues about your past. Uncover the mysteries of these unknown lands and find a way to escape!

Explore

Travel across the archipelago! Each island has its own story, new challenges, and opportunities to discover settlements, mysterious ruins, or puzzling artifacts. Complete quests and follow clues to regain your lost memories!

Craft and build

Gather resources and craft items and tools to help you survive. Build new structures and develop farms to secure essential resources. Your creativity and skills will be key to survival and to unlocking the secrets of the archipelago!

Solve mysteries

Step by step, uncover the history of this place and its inhabitants. Complete missions to solve all the secrets and uncover the truth about your past. Every accomplished task will bring you closer to finding the path to escape!

Fight

Face dangerous creatures. Defeat powerful bosses and defend your base from unwelcome intruders. Craft essential equipment to increase your chances against tougher enemies and gain the upper hand!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-10100F / AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 Super / AMD Radeon RX 6500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400F / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1200 MB available space
